description:
## Why

`pkix-lint::EvaluationReport` is the canonical output of a lint run. Under Level 3 OSCAL alignment, it IS an OSCAL Assessment Results document, just typed in Rust.

## What

Reshape `EvaluationReport` so its fields and structure correspond 1:1 to OSCAL Assessment Results:

- `assessment-results.uuid` — generated UUID per run.
- `assessment-results.metadata` — `title`, `last-modified` (= evaluated_at), `version`, `oscal-version`, `props` (carrying `rule-bundle-version`).
- `assessment-results.import-ap` — reference to an Assessment Plan (caller-supplied or minimal stub).
- `assessment-results.results[]` — typically one Result per run, containing:
  - `uuid`, `title`, `description`, `start`, `end` (= evaluation start / end time).
  - `findings[]` — see PKIX-9vnx.4.
  - `observations[]` — see PKIX-9vnx.4 (Findings reference Observations).
  - `risks[]` — see PKIX-9vnx.5 (DeviatedFindings become Risks with status=deviation-approved).
  - `reviewed-controls` — references to the Controls (lints) that were evaluated.

Existing fields like `profile_id` and `rule_bundle_version` map onto OSCAL's existing slots (`profile_id` → `reviewed-controls.control-objective-selections[].control-id` or similar; `rule_bundle_version` → `metadata.props[name=rule-bundle-version]`).

## Acceptance

- [ ] `EvaluationReport` Rust type has fields named per OSCAL conventions (or wraps an inner OSCAL Assessment Results struct).
- [ ] Serde round-trips against the NIST OSCAL JSON Schema (or via oscal-cli validation in CI).
- [ ] Existing tests that construct `EvaluationReport` updated.
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry documenting the breaking change.

## Depends on

PKIX-9vnx.2 (OSCAL Rust binding must exist before we can field-align).
notes:
Reframed 2026-05-11 (Arch 2 — see PKIX-ztmr / PKIX-9vnx notes):

- Title intent shifts from 'realign EvaluationReport TO OSCAL Assessment Results' to 'add OSCAL Assessment Results serializer for EvaluationReport.'
- EvaluationReport's Rust shape does NOT need to mirror OSCAL field-for-field. Internal fields stay lean and lint-work-tailored.
- Deliverable: `pkix_lint::oscal::emit::assessment_results(report: &EvaluationReport) -> serde_json::Value` (or equivalent), producing JSON that validates against oscal_assessment-results_schema.json v1.2.2.
- Acceptance: serializer round-trips against NIST OSCAL schema (re-emit + reparse fidelity for the EvaluationReport projection).
- No longer blocked by PKIX-9vnx.2 (closed).
title: Realign EvaluationReport to OSCAL Assessment Results
